wisdom.label: Words of Wisdom
wisdom.quote_0: One day our suffering will turn into the strength of those who do not forget.
wisdom.quote_1: I'm for truth, no matter who tells it. I'm for justice, no matter who it is for or against.
wisdom.quote_2: The man who views the world at 50 the same as he did at 20 has wasted 30 years of his life.
wisdom.quote_3: Do not let your difficulties fill you with anxiety; after all, it is only in the darkest nights that stars shine more brightly.
wisdom.quote_4: The strongest among you is the one who controls his anger.
wisdom.quote_5: If justice is done to others, even against your own interests, it will bring you eternal glory.
wisdom.quote_6: Raise your words, not your voice. It is rain that grows flowers, not thunder.
wisdom.quote_7: People who are really strong lift others up. People who are really powerful bring others together.
wisdom.quote_8: Nations are not defeated by invasion; they are defeated by the loss of their inner self.
wisdom.quote_9: When you see oppression, you are no longer a bystander — you are a participant.
wisdom.quote_10: Help your brother, whether he is an oppressor or he is oppressed. If he is the oppressor, prevent him from oppressing; that is your help to him.
wisdom.quote_11: Silence in the face of injustice is a silent agreement to the injustice.
wisdom.quote_12: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
wisdom.quote_13: A people without the knowledge of their past history, origin, and culture is like a tree without roots.
wisdom.quote_14: Do not be people without minds of your own, saying that if others treat you well you will treat them well. Instead, accustom yourselves to do good if people do good and not to do wrong if they do evil.
wisdom.quote_16: Be like a diamond, precious and rare, not like a stone found everywhere.
wisdom.quote_17: The best of people are those that bring most benefit to the rest of mankind.
wisdom.quote_18: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
wisdom.quote_19: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
wisdom.quote_20: My humanity is bound up in yours, for we can only be human together.
wisdom.quote_21: The ink of the scholar is more holy than the blood of the martyr.
wisdom.quote_22: To get what you love, you must first be patient with what you hate.
wisdom.quote_23: Do not lose hope, nor be sad.
wisdom.quote_24: If you want to focus more on Allah in your prayers, focus more on Him outside of your prayers.
wisdom.quote_25: Take account of yourselves before you are taken to account.
wisdom.quote_26: Let not the hatred of a people swerve you away from justice. Be just, for that is closest to righteousness.
wisdom.quote_27: The more you let go, the higher you rise.
wisdom.quote_28: True power is holding back when you have the ability to strike.
wisdom.quote_29: We carry inside us the wonders we seek outside us.
